note:
Checkpoint F6 (Examples library UI) protected baseline. Pins, by SHA-256 + byte length, the F6-OWNED UI, runtime logic, view-model projector and generator that F7 (expand 9->60 examples) MUST NOT redesign: examples-library.css, examples-library.ui.js, examples-library-core.js, src/shared/examples/f6/library.js and engine/generate-examples-library.js. It deliberately does NOT pin two DATA-bearing outputs, which are protected differently:
 - examples.html: pinned to its F6 state by the F4b and F5 protected baselines (it is a pre-existing page those baselines already track); its data-bearing regions are regenerated from the F5 canonical between LIBRARY-GENERATED markers.
 - assets/examples-library.js: this is a NEW generated payload, NOT pinned by F4b/F5 (it did not exist at F4b/F5). It is protected instead by deterministic canonical generation (engine/generate-examples-library.js), the generator --check gate (stale output fails the build), and the F6 projection tests — not by a byte hash here.
This split is what makes "F7 adds data without changing the F6 UI" enforceable: F7 adds catalogue records and regenerates the two data-bearing outputs, while every file pinned in this baseline stays byte-identical.
